## 🏷️ Short Name
<!-- A short, clear name for the story -->
e.g., User Login

## 📖 Full User Story
As a **<type of user>**, I want to **<perform an action>**, so that I can **<achieve a goal>**.  

Example:  
_As a registered user, I want to log into the system using email and password, so that I can access my personal budget data._
